messages.en: As a knight, his skill is said to rank first or second in the whole kingdom. But since he always wears a mask, few have ever seen his face, let alone learned who he really is.[page]In battle, his crimson cape streams behind him as he charges deep into enemy lines, greatsword in hand! He is a knight of true courage.[page]Favorite thing: "Peace"[br]Favorite person: "Lisa Weathers"[br]Catchphrase: "We must bring peace to this world, and soon."[END]

messages.note: small 8x8 font, 1 byte/char, dakuten/handakuten as separate glyph preceding the kana; FA=br FB=page FE=end
messages.en: Deep in a certain forest lived a gentle girl who loved nature and all its animals. She lived very happily with her father, but even she had a few little worries.[page]Beautiful wings had sprouted from her back, big horns had grown on her head, and lately she had learned to control fire at will.[page]Favorite saying: "Take care of nature!"[br]Favorite person: "Dad"[br]Catchphrase: "Am I... weird?"[END]

messages.note: small 8x8 font, 1 byte/char, dakuten/handakuten as separate glyph preceding the kana; FA=br FB=page FE=end
messages.en: The fourth member of Neo Edo Defense Force Special Unit 8, known as "E.S.P. 8" and famed as the strongest unit in Neo Edo.[page]He secretly adores a woman called "Midori." Her full name is Ruria Midori Lucia, a third-generation American. In fact the feeling is mutual, but neither of them has noticed.[page]Favorite words: "Where none have gone before!"[br]Favorite person: "Ruria Midori Lucia"[br]Catchphrase: "I'll cut you down!"[END]
